cohort: The study included single pregnant women aged 16-49 years with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) who were in their third trimester and gave birth at the Obstetrics department of Hangzhou Linping District Women & Children Hospital between December 1, 2023, and April 20, 2024.
finding: Higher ApoA-1 levels were associated with a lower risk of preterm birth, while a higher ApoB/ApoA-1 ratio was associated with a higher risk of preterm birth in pregnant women with GDM in the third trimester.
